caption: The drawing shows a ball-peen hammer depicted in three views on a beige background. The main object, the hammer, is displayed horizontally with its head on the left and handle extending to the right. The hammer head is metallic, shaded in gray and dark brown tones, with a rounded peen and a flat striking face. The wooden handle is drawn in varying shades of brown, with visible wood grain texture and some irregular markings. Below the hammer, to the left, there is a small front-facing view of the hammer head, colored in similar metallic tones, showing the width and shape of the head with more detail in shadow and highlight. To the right of this, there is an outline drawing of the hammer head in a top-down view, with faint pencil lines and no color fill. The background is an even, light beige color, and the artist's name and year "LLOYD C. LEMCKE 1937" is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Fish Marker
